summary: SFL Corporation Ltd., a Bermuda-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, attaching its preliminary Q2 2026 earnings press release. The release announced quarterly results, a $0.22 per share dividend, operational highlights, and business updates including new charters and an equity raise. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situations transaction is described. The filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, which does not constitute a special situation as defined.
